text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up training for the day,
Aston
Machan and I are walking along
when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's really pushing herself, huh? It
kinda
makes me feel like going all out
too. I'm gonna
snap a quick pic of her
running.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Lightbulb. If I, too, can preserve an
image
of myself working hard for
posterity, then...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. Is your camera ready?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You wanna run too, Machan?! Why
don't we
race, then?! You and me!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave a stronger impression in the
photos if I'm
actually racing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Take all the pictures you like,
everybody. All I ask
is that you flood
your socials with them
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon after, Aston Machan showcases her
spirit,
Twin Turbo's passion heats up
even further, and
the two of them push
each other to their very
limits.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... But yes, I suppose you're right. I
can't
think of anything less cool than
flagging out from
exhaustion partway
through.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can resist the temptation. I'll be
responsible and
withdraw for today.
